mechanism_claims.claim_text: Botryllin exposure is associated with microbial envelope damage and lysis in bacteria and yeast; this is direct morphological evidence, not a molecular target assignment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM supports cell-wall/plasma-membrane morphology changes; it does not identify a specific molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Botryllin increases microbial and yeast cell death in viability assays, with antibody pre-incubation reducing or blocking the effect in reported conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: botryllin synthetic mature peptide and anti-botryllin antibody controls
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level percentages are read as qualitative/rounded source statements unless explicitly stated in text; no numeric bar extraction is invented.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Botryllin transcript/protein evidence localizes the peptide to Botryllus morula cells and released extracellular material during microbial exposure.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: native botryllin in Botryllus schlosseri haemocytes
mechanism_claims.limitations: Localization supports biological context for release/storage; it is not itself an antimicrobial endpoint measurement.
